sections.title: Calm grooms for *nervous pups*
body: Not every dog is comfortable being groomed. Cindy Strickland specializes in difficult, nervous, anxious and senior dogs, and takes the time to build trust so every visit is as calm and positive as it can be.

Hand-stripping is a special technique for wire-coated breeds: instead of clipping, we gently remove the dead, loose outer hairs by hand or with a stripping tool, which keeps the coat’s natural texture, color and health.
list: Difficult, anxious and senior dogs welcome
Two shampoos and conditioner with every bath

items.title: Cindy Strickland
items.text: 20 years of professional grooming, with a gift for nervous and senior dogs.

items.title: Isabel Igoe
items.text: Loves one-on-one time, learning each dog’s personality and helping them feel at home.

items.title: Carla Igoe
items.text: A lifelong Aiken resident grooming dogs for over 20 years, and an avid foxhunter.

items.title: Rachel Cleveland
items.text: In training, with plenty of dog-industry experience; a great pick for bath pups.

items.a: Call or text (803) 998-7285, or book online through our Square appointments page. Appointments run Monday to Friday, with some Saturday mornings.

items.q: Why might my price be higher than listed?
items.a: Prices are starting points. Coat condition, size and behavior can all change how long a groom takes.

items.q: My dog gets anxious. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Cindy specializes in difficult, nervous, anxious and senior dogs and takes the time to build trust.
